correctness.rationale: Hermite ambiguity identity yields squared radial multipliers φ_j=e^(−x)L_j(x)² for j=0,1,2. L2 roots r±=2±√2 imply two exact lower precision-covering constraints. A strictly positive dual vector certifies minimal w0+w1=Ct with C≈5.984283368174 and unique normalized unit solution α0≈0.929064805486, α1≈5.055218562688. Bounding the disk endpoint x=R gives M3≤F_R−CF_R²+o(F_R²). Feasible weights (1+√F_R)F_R(α0,α1), 1−(1+√F_R)C F_R, satisfy global lower bound after neighborhoods of quadratic zeros, compact complement and monotone x≥7 tail, yielding equality to second order. Every optimizer has normalized limit (α0,α1) by bounded subsequences and LP uniqueness. Independently checked roots, dual balances and several finite radii; numerical finite checks are not the asymptotic proof.
